name: codex-account-switcher
description: Windows desktop switcher for Codex app accounts
author: XinTycd

scripts.package: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:Path='C:\\Program Files (x86)\\NSIS;C:\\Program Files (x86)\\NSIS\\Bin;' + $env:Path; & \"$env:USERPROFILE\\go\\bin\\wails.exe\" build -nsis; $src='build\\bin\\XinT Codex Account Switcher-amd64-installer.exe'; $dst='build\\bin\\XinT-Codex-Account-Switcher-v1.0.0-installer-amd64.exe'; if (Test-Path $src) { Copy-Item $src $dst -Force }"
scripts.package:installer: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:Path='C:\\Program Files (x86)\\NSIS;C:\\Program Files (x86)\\NSIS\\Bin;' + $env:Path; & \"$env:USERPROFILE\\go\\bin\\wails.exe\" build -nsis; $src='build\\bin\\XinT Codex Account Switcher-amd64-installer.exe'; $dst='build\\bin\\XinT-Codex-Account-Switcher-v1.0.0-installer-amd64.exe'; if (Test-Path $src) { Copy-Item $src $dst -Force }"
